<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><title>The Lulu Express: Final Quiz</title>
<style>
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;padding:16px 12px 40px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0,#6a2f55,transparent 45%),linear-gradient(180deg,#3a2230,#241519);background-attachment:fixed;color:#f4e6ec;font-family:Georgia,serif;min-height:100vh;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
main{max-width:480px;margin:0 auto}
h1{font-size:26px;text-align:center;color:#ffc2d6;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,111,181,.55);margin:6px 0 14px}
h2{margin:4px 0 8px;font-size:21px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd98a,#ff9ec9);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#5a3a4c,#3d2833);border:2px solid #d8b865;border-radius:22px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #241519,0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 0 18px rgba(255,111,181,.18)}
p{line-height:1.45;margin:8px 0}
.big{font-size:30px;text-align:center;color:#ffe08a;margin:8px 0}
.q{font-size:20px;margin:10px 0 14px}
.meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:14px;color:#d9c2cc;margin-bottom:6px}
.bar{height:8px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:8px}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff9ec9,#ffd98a);width:0;transition:width .3s}
button{display:block;width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:17px;padding:13px 12px;margin:9px 0;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #e0c070;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#d77a98,#b2506f);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #6e2d44;text-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
button:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:none}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff}
button.ok{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#58c58a,#2f8a58);box-shadow:0 3px 0 #1d5a38}
button.no{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#85707a,#5c4a53);box-shadow:0 3px 0 #3a2c33}
button.sm{display:inline-block;width:auto;font-size:14px;padding:8px 12px;margin:4px 0}
input{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:18px;padding:11px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #e0c070;margin:6px 0}
.tk{border-radius:14px;border:2px dashed #7a4a5f;padding:12px;text-align:left;margin:10px 0;color:#3a2230}
.bc{height:34px;margin-top:8px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#222 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px,#222 5px 6px,transparent 6px 10px)}
.line{user-select:all;-webkit-user-select:all;background:#fff0f5;color:#3a2230;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;font-weight:bold}
small{color:#d9c2cc}
.cf{position:fixed;top:-20px;z-index:9;pointer-events:none;transition:transform 3s ease-in,opacity 3s}
</style></head><body><main>
<h1>🚂 The Lulu Express<br>Final Quiz</h1>
<div class="card" id="app"></div>
<p style="text-align:center"><small id="rs"></small></p>
</main>
<script>
const dx=b=>{let k='lulu',a=atob(b),u=new Uint8Array(a.length);for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)u[i]=a.charCodeAt(i)^k.charCodeAt(i%4);return new TextDecoder().decode(u)};
const QS=dx('').trim().split('\n').map(l=>l.split('|')),RC=dx('XEZfRQ==');
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),app=$('#app'),K='lulu-final-quiz';
let st={};try{st=JSON.parse(localStorage[K]||'{}')}catch(e){}
const sv=()=>{try{localStorage[K]=JSON.stringify(st)}catch(e){}};
const sh=a=>{a=a.slice();for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a};
const esc=x=>String(x).replace(/[<>&"'`]/g,'').slice(0,16);
const ft=ms=>{let s=Math.round(ms/1000);return Math.floor(s/60)+':'+String(s%60).padStart(2,'0')};
let AC;function snd(k){try{AC=AC||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();AC.resume();const t=AC.currentTime,n=(f,s,d,ty,v)=>{const o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();o.type=ty||'sine';o.frequency.value=f;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t+s);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(v||.12,t+s+.02);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+s+d);o.connect(g);g.connect(AC.destination);o.start(t+s);o.stop(t+s+d+.05)};
 if(k=='ok'){n(988,0,.25);n(1319,.08,.35)}else if(k=='no')n(110,0,.3,'sawtooth',.08);else if(k=='fan')[523,659,784,1047,784,1047].forEach((f,i)=>n(f,i*.14,.4,'square',.07));else n(520,0,.05,'sine',.05)}catch(e){}}
function conf(){const a=['💗','✨','🎉','🌸','⭐'];for(let i=0;i<36;i++){const s=document.createElement('span');s.className='cf';s.textContent=a[i%5];s.style.left=Math.random()*100+'%';s.style.fontSize=(14+Math.random()*16)+'px';document.body.append(s);requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{s.style.transform='translate('+(Math.random()*120-60)+'px,'+(innerHeight+60)+'px) rotate('+Math.random()*720+'deg)';s.style.opacity=.2}));setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),3500)}}
const TI=r=>r>=47?['💎','Platinum Boarding Pass','#d8d2f0','Lulu\u2019s Snapchat and access to her private story, OR a 1-hour private audio call with Lulu 📱']:r>=40?['🥇','Gold Boarding Pass','#f3d98a','A personalised voice note where you choose exactly what Lulu says, up to 5 minutes long 🎙️']:r>=30?['🥈','Silver Boarding Pass','#dfe3ea','A kiss on mic 💋']:['🎀','Participation Award','#ffd6e4','Thank you for riding the Lulu Express! 💗'];
function intro(){app.innerHTML=`<h2>Ready for the final quiz?</h2><p>⚠️ You only get <b>ONE chance</b>. If you leave or refresh, your chance is used up.</p><p>💎 Platinum: 47+/50<br>🥇 Gold: 40+/50<br>🥈 Silver: 30+/50<br>🎀 Under 30: a participation award</p><p>50 questions about Liliana. Your time is shown on your boarding pass ⏱</p><label for="nm">Your name</label><input id="nm" maxlength="16" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Enter your name"><button id="go">I am ready 💗</button>`;$('#go').onclick=()=>{const n=esc($('#nm').value.trim());if(!n){$('#nm').focus();return}st={started:1,name:n};sv();snd('tap');run()}}
function run(){const Q=sh(QS),t0=Date.now();let n=0,sc=0,iv;
 const done=()=>{clearInterval(iv);const ms=Date.now()-t0;st.res={r:sc,ms};sv();result()};
 (function q(){if(n>=50)return done();const[x,a,...w]=Q[n];app.innerHTML=`<div class="meta"><span>Question ${n+1}/50 · ✅ ${sc} correct</span><span id="tm">⏱ ${ft(Date.now()-t0)}</span></div><div class="bar"><i style="width:${n*2}%"></i></div><p class="q">${x}</p>`;
  sh([a,...w]).forEach(t=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=t;b.onclick=()=>{app.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(z=>z.disabled=1);const ok=t==a;b.className=ok?'ok':'no';if(ok)sc++;snd(ok?'ok':'no');n++;setTimeout(q,600)};app.append(b)})})();
 iv=setInterval(()=>{const e=$('#tm');if(e)e.textContent='⏱ '+ft(Date.now()-t0)},1000)}
function result(){const{r,ms}=st.res,t=TI(r),nm=st.name||'Player',line=`${nm} · ${r}/50 · ${t[1]} · ⏱ ${ft(ms)}`;
 app.innerHTML=`<h2>Quiz complete! 🎉</h2><div class="tk" style="background:${t[2]}"><b>🚂 THE LULU EXPRESS · BOARDING PASS</b><br>PASSENGER: <b>${nm}</b><br>CLASS: <b>${t[0]} ${t[1].replace(' Boarding Pass','').toUpperCase()}</b><br>SCORE: <b>${r}/50</b><br>TIME: <b>${ft(ms)}</b><br>GATE: Lulu Olympics · Sat 9 PM PDT<div class="bc"></div></div><p>${t[3]}</p>${r>=30?'<p>🏁 All Platinum Boarding Pass holders progress to the finals. If fewer than 3 players earn Platinum, the next highest scorers will also progress. The finals are on HelloTalk and are a songwriting and singing competition 🎤 Speak directly to Liliana for your next instructions.</p>':''}<p>📸 Screenshot this boarding pass and keep it as proof of your prize.</p><p>📩 Send this to Liliana so she can see your result:</p><p class="line" id="ln">${line}</p><button id="cp">Copy my result 📋</button>`;
 $('#cp').onclick=async()=>{const el=$('#ln');try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.textContent);$('#cp').textContent='Copied!'}catch(e){const g=document.createRange();g.selectNodeContents(el);const s=getSelection();s.removeAllRanges();s.addRange(g);$('#cp').textContent='Selected. Tap Copy'}};
 if(r>=30){snd('fan');conf()}}
function boot(){$('#rs').innerHTML='<a href="#" id="rl" style="color:#d9c2cc">Quiz reset</a>';$('#rl').onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();app.innerHTML='<h2>🔁 Quiz reset</h2><p>Enter the private code to take the quiz again.</p><input id="rc" type="password" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="8"><button id="ro">Unlock</button><p id="rm"></p><button class="sm" id="rb">Back</button>';$('#ro').onclick=()=>{if($('#rc').value===RC){st={};sv();intro()}else $('#rm').textContent='Wrong code 🔒'};$('#rb').onclick=boot2};boot2()}
function boot2(){if(st.res)result();else if(st.started)app.innerHTML='<h2>Your chance is used 💔</h2><p>The final quiz can only be taken once, and it was started on this phone.</p>';else intro()}
boot();
</script></body></html>
